text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This happened when I went to the cafeteria 
to grab some food...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeeouch, that's spicy~! Shoot, water, 
water, water~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't just grass, it's a whole 
forest—no, the whole Amazon! Aha, all I 
can do is laugh!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it obvious? I'm eating the new 
product."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Max spicy flavor? That's insane! We gotta 
ride this big wave, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, my mouth is seriously on fire. I 
can't take it anymore. I give up...
See? Just like I told ya, right? I win!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Tch, thought I'd be able to put up a bit 
more of a fight..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What do you mean, a showdown?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a bet, a bet! A bet with Nakayama! On 
whether you can finish those super spicy 
snacks!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so, you giving up means I won! That 
calls for a "Thank you very much" victory 
dance-y♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh! Giving up's off the table! Just 
watch me, I'm gonna eat every last bite!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's for real from here on out. Time to 
ride this super spicy big wave!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! That's super hype! Vibes are 
up, mood is lit, okie-dokie waaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What's up? Are Jordan and the others up to 
something fun again?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come on! Everybody saaaaay! Jordan's~~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Let's see something awesome, show me what 
you got--!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ......I wanna see you do something cool~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why you! What are you doing blending 
in like that?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! A nail-biting comeback... Now 
that's enticing."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold on a sec, you guys. Her 
mouth's clearly hit its limit, right? 
Chanting ain't gonna fix that—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmph... *crunch crunch*... *gulp*! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're eating it, really?! How easily 
influenced are you, you idiot?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't mess with me! There ain't a call or 
a trend out there that I can't ride!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Eat up, eat up, eat up♪ Show everyone 
even more of what makes you great♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To the cheers of the crowd, Tosen Jordan 
shoved one super-spicy snack into her 
mouth after another. She was down to the 
very last bite, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"So spicy... ugh, oof... mmmph! My lips 
are burning, they're tingling so bad...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, but like heck... I'm gonna let 
myself lose hereee~!!
choice_data_list: C'mon, Jordan, show us your guts!
Guzzle that water with all your might!
Drink that water with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, but like heck... I'm gonna let 
myself lose hereee~!!
choice_data_list: C'mon, Jordan, show us your guts!
Guzzle that water with all your might!
Drink that water with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! Finished it! I won!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean... pfft, what was with those 
call-outs earlier?! Way too over-the-top 
passionate~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I somehow managed to scarf it down 
in the heat of the moment, though!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyy!! Let's go take a victory 
selfieee!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, gather 'round! You too, come 
on, hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! And Golshi! I'm gonna take a picture 
of her frustrated face too――

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait... isn't that guy missing?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm back. I just told them... I was gonna 
go watch a recording of 'Mellow Rakshasa 
Cuisine.'"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? What's that about!? I'm already 
stinging like crazy over here!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, what is with that guuuuyyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! *gulp* *gulp*... *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *cough*... Alright, I washed it all down!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Jordan~!! You're totally hyping 
up the whole floor, girl~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~. Like seriously, might makes right, 
for real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I won!! How do you like that, 
Golshi! This is totally my win!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dammit! Dammiiit!! ...Still, I'm so moved!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I took a picture. Of you, 
dripping with sweat, gulping down water—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Delete it! I look totally hideous!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"—and flanked on both sides by mantis 
shrimp and spiny lobster pics. I edited it 
real nice, so make it your lock screen, 
okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I DON'T NEED THIIIS!!
